fal-ai/got-ocr/v2.description: GOT-OCR 2.0 specialty formatted-document OCR via fal.ai
fal-ai/got-ocr/v2.pricingNotes: fal.ai lists GOT-OCR 2.0 at $0.05 per input image. AutoShow renders PDFs to one PNG per page and submits one image per request, so pricing is $50 per 1,000 pages; taxes, credits, and discounts are excluded.

limits.notes: The endpoint accepts image URLs. AutoShow renders PDF pages to PNG and sends direct PNG/JPG/WEBP images as data URIs. It submits one image per request with do_format=true to preserve specialty formatted content.

fal-ai/florence-2-large/ocr.description: Florence-2 Large general OCR via fal.ai
fal-ai/florence-2-large/ocr.pricingNotes: fal.ai charges $0.00125 per GPU compute second. AutoShow estimates $7.55 per 1,000 pages from the 2026-08-14 Florence OCR benchmark: 29 pages took 175.099 observed wall seconds, or 6.038 seconds per page on average. This is a benchmark-calibrated estimate, not an invoice amount: billed GPU seconds may vary by image and runtime.

limits.notes: The endpoint accepts one image_url. AutoShow renders PDF pages to PNG and sends direct PNG/JPG/WEBP images as data URIs, one image per request.
